moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's last public holiday of summer falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a busy weekend for travel and events across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Hands up if you're already planning that Bank Holiday getaway! Just a heads-up, it's the last long weekend of summer in England, Wales & NI, so expect busy roads and rails from Friday. Where are you off to?

angles.name: Last Summer Hurrah
angles.copy: That August Bank Holiday feeling is just around the corner! One last chance for a BBQ, a day trip, or just putting your feet up. How are you making the most of the long weekend?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest rock and indie festivals, Reading & Leeds, takes over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 28-30, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence And The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost HERE! Who are you buzzing to see this weekend? Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C... it's going to be HUGE!

angles.name: Live Music Weekend
angles.copy: The fields are ready, the stages are set! Reading & Leeds Festival kicks off this Friday for three days of incredible live music. Catch the highlights on Nation Radio!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The electronic dance music giant, Creamfields, takes place in Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-29, with Calvin Harris, Underworld, and Sonny Fodera headlining a stacked lineup.

angles.name: Dance Nation
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is just around the corner! Get ready to rave with Calvin Harris, Underworld, Sonny Fodera and more this weekend. Who's heading to Daresbury?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown to Creamfields is ON! The UK's biggest dance festival brings the party to Cheshire from Thursday. Expect epic sets and unforgettable vibes.

moments.title: All Points East London Continues
moments.blurb: All Points East continues its run in London's Victoria Park until August 30th, bringing a diverse lineup of artists to the capital.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is still bringing the heat to Victoria Park! If you're in London, there's still time to catch some incredible acts before it wraps up this weekend.

angles.name: East London Music
angles.copy: More live music action in London this week as All Points East continues! Who's had an amazing time at Victoria Park so far?

moments.title: Shambala Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The independent and sustainably-focused Shambala Festival is happening from August 27-30, known for its diverse music, arts, and immersive experiences.

angles.name: Beyond the Mainstream
angles.copy: Shambala Festival is back for another year of 'Adventures in Utopia' this weekend! If you're looking for something a bit different, this is the place to be.

angles.name: Sustainable Celebration
angles.copy: Good vibes and green living! Shambala Festival kicks off on Thursday, proving you can have an amazing time and still be radically sustainable. Enjoy the magic!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Approaching
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of Strictly Come Dancing will launch its pre-recorded show on Saturday, September 19th, with live shows starting a week later, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter, glamour, and maybe a few dropped lifts! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is just weeks away on September 19th. Who are you backing to win the Glitterball this year?

angles.name: New Hosts on the Block
angles.copy: New era, new hosts! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking the Strictly reins. Excited to see their chemistry when the show launches September 19th?

moments.title: Football Season in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Premier League, EFL, and Scottish Premiership seasons are well underway, with matches happening throughout the week and leading up to the Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Matchday Buzz
angles.copy: Another week, another round of football! The Premier League and EFL are in full flow. Who are you hoping gets a win for your team this week?

angles.name: Early Season Form
angles.copy: Three games in, and the league tables are starting to take shape. Any early predictions for who'll be lifting silverware (or fighting relegation) this season?
